scope: Selected critical primary-source citation audit; all track narratives inspected. This is not a proof audit of all cited works, legal clearance, or an all-links availability test.
inventory_method: Literal HTTP(S) token discovery from public root/docs/archive/artifacts Markdown plus explicit external URLs in data/references.json. Audit files, generated site and git internals excluded. URLs are not fetched solely because inventoried; exact URL matching does not conflate PDF/abs/HTML aliases. No HTTP status codes inferred from tool output.
